answer: A sybil farm cannot cheaply wander into established status because each identity must stake POA on a public ledge and maintain reputation through continuous attestation. The tide of new epochs erodes unattended stakes: miss two rounds and the bond forfeits. Cloning 100 identities needs 100 separate stakes, 100 attestation streams, and 100 decay timers in parallel. Cost scales linearly with headcount while rewards plateau, so the farm spends more than it earns. Detection slashes all collateral in clusters sharing a signing pattern.
